children: Noble Corp plc (NE) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 26, 2026.
On October 27, 2026, the President and Chief Executive Officer of Noble Corporation plc

, Robert W. Eifler, together with other executive officers, plan to announce Noble Corporation plc's earnings for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, via teleconference, which will be open to the public and broadcast live over the internet. A copy of the slide presentation used in connection with the teleconference is attached as Exhibit 99.2 and is incorporated by reference into this item. Pursuant to the rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission, the slide presentation is being furnished and shall not be deemed to be "filed" under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895262/000189526226000147/ne-20261026.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895262/000189526226000147/0001895262-26-000147-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
